type: Original textbook factual errata, not OCR

sources.finding: Organic rules prohibit most synthetic pesticides and fertilizers, rather than all chemicals.
Organic practices emphasize soil and water quality, biodiversity and limiting synthetic inputs; allowed substances remain permitted.
Summary and Introduction: peanut pods develop underground. Summary and Fertilization: legumes and associated bacteria can add nitrogen; crop rotation does not mean every crop adds minerals.
Nutrition section: organic describes production standards, not guaranteed nutrient content. Both organic and conventional produce provide important nutrients.
